era: Upper Paleolithic Inception / MIS 3 Interstadial & Sahul Maritime Colonization

overview.summary_fr: Reconstitution cartographique et tensorielle globale de la Terre pour l'époque -50 000 BP. Cette période est marquée par la première colonisation humaine du continent Sahul (Australie et Nouvelle-Guinée) via des traversées maritimes hauturières à travers la ligne Wallacea (Madjedbebe, Carpenter's Gap), la diffusion du Paléolithique supérieur initial en Eurasie (Bacho Kiro, Bohunicien), et la coexistence avec les derniers Néandertaliens et Dénisoviens d'altitude. Les Amériques restent rigoureusement inhabitées.
overview.summary_en: Global cartographic and tensor reconstruction for the -50,000 BP epoch. Marked by the first maritime human colonization of Sahul (Australia and New Guinea) across the deep-water Wallacea line, the Initial Upper Paleolithic dispersal in Eurasia, and coexistence with late Neanderthals and high-altitude Denisovans. The Americas remain strictly uninhabited.

data_sources: GEBCO 2023 Grid Bathymetric and Topographic Model

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.paleotopographic_features: Sundaland shelf fully exposed; Sahul land bridge connecting Australia and New Guinea; Beringia land bridge emerged.

elevation.reconstitution_rationale: Global eustatic depression of -75m during MIS 3 interstadial exposing the Arafura shelf and Sunda shelf, narrowing Wallacean water gaps.

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.australian_megafaunal_savanna: Semi-arid eucalyptus woodland and interior lake systems (Lake Mungo precursors)
scientific_parameters_and_corrections.mammoth_steppe_eurasia: Mammoth steppe belt spanning from Western Europe to Eastern Siberia

biomes.reconstitution_rationale: Moderate interstadial warming during MIS 3 supporting rich megafaunal grazing ecosystems across Eurasia and Australia.

data_sources: EPICA Dome C Ice Core Series
NGRIP Greenland Ice Core Dansgaard-Oeschger (DO-14/13) Events

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.interstadial_thermal_oscillation: Mild warming DO cycle with temperate European summer refugia

temperature.reconstitution_rationale: Colder than Holocene baseline by ~3°C, but significantly warmer than the upcoming LGM peak.

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.sahul_monsoon_activity: Active tropical monsoon sustaining northern Australian wetlands and savannahs

precipitation.reconstitution_rationale: Moderate rainfall across Sahul facilitating rapid human expansion along coastal and riverine corridors.

data_sources: Astronomical Milankovitch Parameters at 50,000 BP (Laskar et al. 2004)
seasonality.reconstitution_rationale: Moderate seasonal thermal swing in mid-latitudes.

data_sources: Clarkson et al. (2017) 'Human occupation of northern Australia by 65,000 years ago' (Madjedbebe)
O'Connell & Allen (2015) 'The process, biotic impact, and global significance of the human colonization of Sahul'
Tallavaara et al. (2015) Human Carrying Capacity in MIS 3
density.reconstitution_rationale: First appearance of human population in Australia (Sahul) while the New World remains strictly uninhabited.

data_sources: Glottolog Sahul and Eurasian Paleolithic Nodes

clades_separated: Proto-Sapiens African Core (Ancestral Click & Complex Phoneme Stock)
Initial Upper Paleolithic Eurasian Dispersal Lineages
Proto-Australian & Papuan Maritime Pioneer Language Stock

isogloss.reconstitution_rationale: Separates ancestral Sahul linguistic roots from African and Eurasian Upper Paleolithic dispersions.

sovereignty.reconstitution_rationale: Egalitarian band home ranges and totemic landscape boundaries.

data_sources: Keen (2004) 'Aboriginal Economy and Society: Australia at the Threshold of Colonisation'

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.sahul_kinship_mode: Skin / Moiety Section Systems with Totemic Landscape Alliances
scientific_parameters_and_corrections.eurasian_kinship_mode: Bilateral Exogamous Upper Paleolithic Foraging Networks

kinship.reconstitution_rationale: Early manifestation of complex multi-band marriage rules and totemic moieties in Sahul.

data_sources: Bowler et al. (2003) Lake Mungo 3 Ochre Inhumation (42 ka proxy)
Bacho Kiro Cave Pendants and Personal Ornaments (Hublin et al. 2020)

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.ochre_cremation_and_grave_goods: Widespread ritual use across Sahul and Eurasia

rituals.reconstitution_rationale: High symbolic and personal ornament expression across all Sapiens groups.

data_sources: Initial Upper Paleolithic Blade Technology (Bacho Kiro, Denisova Cave)

key_innovations: Deep-sea ocean watercraft & bamboo/wood raft navigation
Prismatic blade cores & bone/antler projectile points
Edge-ground stone axes in Sahul (earliest in world)

technology.reconstitution_rationale: Technological leap enabling intentional maritime crossing and standardized bladelet production.

institutional.reconstitution_rationale: Egalitarian clan councils with elder ritual authority.

data_sources: Miller et al. (2005) 'Ecosystem Collapse in Pleistocene Australia and a Human Role in Megafaunal Extinction'

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.fire_stick_farming_in_australia: Systematic landscape burning altering vegetation mosaics
scientific_parameters_and_corrections.megafaunal_hunting_pressure: Incipient hunting of Diprotodon and Genyornis

ecological.reconstitution_rationale: First appearance of systematic anthropogenic landscape fire management across Australia.

data_sources: Wolfe et al. (2007) Infectious Disease Biogeography

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.sahul_pathogen_regime: Moderate tropical vector load without Old World herd zoonoses

pathogen.reconstitution_rationale: Distinct epidemiological equilibrium in Sahul isolated from Eurasian zoonoses.

tradenetwork.reconstitution_rationale: Long-distance ceremonial gift exchange (Walanari/Dreamtime songlines precursor).

precious_metals.reconstitution_rationale: Intact alluvial placer gold and silver beds.

geothermal.reconstitution_rationale: Mantle and volcanic heat flux mapping.
